subject: music
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which note value lasts the longest?
questions.explain: A semibreve lasts four beats in 4/4, longer than a minim, crotchet or quaver.

questions.q: Which clef is also known as the G clef and is used for higher-pitched instruments?
questions.explain: The treble (G) clef curls around the G line and is used for higher pitches.

options: A single melodic line with no accompaniment
questions.explain: Monophonic texture is a single unaccompanied melodic line.

questions.q: Compared with a major scale, a (natural) minor key generally sounds:
questions.explain: Minor keys typically sound darker or sadder than the brighter major.

questions.q: Which Italian tempo term means 'fast and lively'?
questions.explain: Allegro means fast and lively, whereas adagio and largo are slow.

questions.q: A sharp sign in front of a note does what?
options: Raises the pitch by a semitone
Lowers the pitch by a semitone
questions.explain: A sharp raises a note's pitch by one semitone.

questions.q: The articulation marking 'staccato' tells a player to make notes:
questions.explain: Staccato means short and detached, the opposite of legato.

questions.q: What does the time signature 3/4 tell you?
options: Three beats in a bar, each a quaver
Three beats in a bar, each a crotchet
Four beats in a bar, each a crotchet
questions.explain: In 3/4 there are three crotchet beats per bar, giving a waltz feel.

questions.q: How many beats does a crotchet last in 4/4 time?
questions.explain: A crotchet lasts one beat in 4/4 time.

questions.q: In music, what does the dynamic marking 'forte' (f) mean?
questions.explain: Forte is an Italian dynamic term meaning loud, while piano means quiet.
Ritardando means to gradually slow the tempo down.

questions.q: A major triad is built from which intervals above the root?
questions.explain: A major triad stacks a major 3rd then a minor 3rd, giving a bright sound.
